Fresh off Jason Schreier’s massive Bloomberg cover story, two brand-new GTA 6 screenshots just dropped and the internet is completely losing its mind over the details! 📸🔥🤯

Talk about a major visual treat straight from Rockstar’s inner circle as the new Bloomberg Businessweek feature brings us two incredible glimpses into Leonida! The first shot drops Jason and Lucia right into the thick of an off-road mud-racing session—looking completely caked in dirt and kicking back with a cold beer. The second screenshot shifts gears entirely to a breathtaking sunset shot along Ocean Drive, showing off neon-lit hotels, a low-flying police helicopter, and a gorgeous luxury sports car (reminiscent of a rebadged Pegassi Zorrusso) glowing under the Miami-inspired evening light. Seeing these crisp, polished visuals right as we enter the final month before launch is the ultimate hype fuel! 🚀✨😎

Which of these two contrasting vibes—the rugged, muddy backcountry or the neon-drenched luxury of Vice City’s strip—are you more excited to explore first? Drop your thoughts down below! 👀👇

Rockstar is stacking GTA 6 with an absolute monster roster of side activities that turn Vice City and the wild swamps of Leonida into the most immersive living playground ever created! 🌴🏀🛶🔥🤯

Talk about a jaw-dropping content drop as the official Extended Look footage reveals an insane variety of things to do way beyond the main crime saga. Whether you’re shooting hoops on local basketball courts, tearing up dirt tracks and circuit races, deep-sea scuba diving past vibrant marine life, base jumping off towering rooftops, or kicking back with some quiet river kayaking and fishing, the level of depth is staggering. Add in weightlifting at the gym, tactical weapons training, wild clubbing, spontaneous store robberies, and backyard wrestling, and you’ve got a world designed to swallow hundreds of hours before you even touch another mission! 🚀✨😎
